verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zoho CRM supports linked records in general: related lists (docs-9), linking (MxN) modules (docs-11) and fetching resource relationships in one query (docs-5). It never names contacts and companies (accounts) as linked modules, and it says nothing about an activity timeline on records. missing for 10: explicit documentation of contact–company (account) linking, any per-record activity timeline or history view, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
